title: Effect.Deep.try_with keeps stack for every effect in bytecode
summary: In bytecode, a handler installed with `Effect.Deep.try_with` or `match_with` keeps stack for every effect it handles: with the stacks limited to 8 MB, a million effects end with `Stack_overflow`. Native code and OCaml 5.4.0 run it in constant stack.

actual.text: Prints `Fatal error: exception Stack overflow`; exit status 2.

cause: `stdlib/effect.ml`, `match_with` and `try_with`: `to_continuation f (Cont k) [@nontail]` where OCaml 5.4.0 has `f k`; native code is right because `to_continuation` is inlined.
reference: related: issue #7918 (bytecode fiber stack grown by a memprof callback; not the same)
